newsitem.title: USA: SS&C Technologies named in lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: SS&C Technologies named in lawsuit.

text.p: SS&C Technologies Inc said on Friday that it was named in a lawsuit related to the company's initial public offering.

SS&C believes that it has highly meritorious defenses to the lawsuit that was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York and intends to defend it vigorously, the software company said SS&C.

The lawsuit alleges that there was an inappropriate foundation for the pricing of the company's initial public offering and improper disclosure regarding how the offering price was established, SS&C said.
The complaint names as defendants the company and its top executives, as well as Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Hambrecht & Quist LLC, the lead managers of the underwriting.
